subject: Hybrid vector text query integration test (#711)
reason: The change is test-and-CI only: it adds hybrid vector/text query cases to integration/test_fulltext.py (refactoring existing assertions into a shared HYBRID_QUERY_EXPECTED_RESULTS table and adding a KNN variant of the same queries) and amends scripts/common.rc to pip-install an extra requirements file. No module source (src/) is modified, so FT.SEARCH behaviour is identical on the change and its parent; there is no changed code path for a scenario to exercise.
